_doc: The scripted captain hopping between the ships of four races (openspec/changes/fleet-skins; the battle console mockup's Four races scene, a quiet sector with nothing underway): pick the scenario from the scene selector, then take each ship in turn with keys 1 to 4 (the console wears each ship's faction's skin) and in each look over two stations and an expanded panel and back; last the Fleet key on the name plate. No battle is fought.
